method: Codex computer use of desktop Chrome through the browser extension, ordinary visible UI actions and native file chooser; DOM observations and screenshots. No application-store injection.

checks.name: Production CAD startup
checks.result: Rendered CAD viewport and toolbar with optional Support KinetiCAD link.

checks.name: Modified imported STEP fixture
checks.result: Native Load project opened Native plate and Imported machined block with imported solid, Hole 1 and Fixed 1 joint. Visible volume 3.69 cm3, position [31,-17,23] mm, rotation [19,-37,61] degrees.

checks.name: Material undo and redo
checks.result: Brass C36000 displayed 8.50 g/cm3 and 0.031 kg. Steel 1018 displayed 7.87 g/cm3 and 0.029 kg. Undo restored selected Brass; Redo restored selected Steel. Volume and pose stayed the same.

checks.name: Durable recovery after refresh
checks.result: Changed to Steel, observed Recovery copy saved on this device, reloaded, selected imported block and confirmed Steel, 0.029 kg, 3.69 cm3, original pose, hole and fixed joint. History empty after reload as documented.
checks.boundary: An earlier immediate reload during an unfinished redo recovery write restored the preceding durable Brass state. Recovery is asynchronous: wait for the saved status; use Save project for a portable backup.

checks.name: Actual downloaded project reopen
checks.result: Clicked Save project, observed complete-project download notice. Changed current material to Brass, opened the actual downloaded JSON with native Load project chooser, then confirmed restored Steel, imported solid, hole, fixed joint, volume and pose.

checks.result: Navigated Home, Story, Privacy and Terms in Chrome. checks.result: Clicked app Support KinetiCAD; a separate Chrome tab opened https://buymeacoffee.com/andrewblumson titled andrew blumson. CAD project remained open.

checks.name: Production simulation canary
checks.result: Opened Windmill via six-card Demos gallery; Try simulation, Play, visible rotor motion, Pause at 24.77 simulated seconds with 2 bodies and 1 revolute joint, then Reset to Stopped at 0.00 s.
checks.boundary: UI startup and controls canary. Numerical windmill accuracy is established separately by the unchanged automated regression in the release capture.

checks.name: Captured browser console
checks.result: Chrome dev logs returned zero warnings and zero errors for both tested CAD and landing tabs.
checks.boundary: Limited to log entries captured for these tabs and this check; not every historical browser session.
